findings.executive_summary: Analyzed 46 positions from 237 snapshots (2026-05-31 to 2026-06-07). 12 positions (26.1%) went deep negative (<=-1R). 38 positions (82.6%) never had trailing SL tighten to <=2x ATR. 23 positions (50.0%) had trailing SL inactive (0.0) at some point. 1 position(s) had frozen tracking data. Excluding the -80R outlier, avg final PnL = 0.4044R, win rate = 66.7%. Average trailing SL distance = 3.45x ATR — this is excessively wide (recommend <=2x ATR).
